levelledPara.title: Severities

row.entry: A condition that needs attention now, such as a value outside its alarm limits or a satellite that may have gone silent.
A condition that may need attention, such as a value outside its caution limits.
Something that happened once, such as a subsystem restart. Events do not clear; you acknowledge them.

levelledPara.para: Each channel can have four limits: alarm low, caution low, caution high and alarm high. A channel without limits shows No limits rather than Nominal, so an empty limit is never mistaken for a good value.

levelledPara.title: What raises an alert

row.entry: Caution after 12 hours; alarm after 24 hours
3 scheduled observations in a row deliver nothing, counting passes at least 15° high, after a 3-hour upload grace period
No successful fetch for three fetch intervals (90 minutes at the default 30)
SatNOGS rejects the API key, or no key is set
Caution below 10% or 1 GB free; alarm below 3% or 300 MB free

levelledPara.para: Channels that drift away from their learned normal are flagged on the channel and in the spacecraft status, and sent to the phone, separately from the limit alerts.

listItem.para: Open, not acknowledged: new. Shown at the top of the list with an Acknowledge button.
Open, acknowledged: an operator has seen it, but the condition is still active.
Shelved: hidden for a chosen time (1 hour, 6 hours, 1 day or 1 week) with a reason. Shelved alerts are listed under Shelved below the main list.
Closed: acknowledged, and the condition has cleared.

note.notePara: An alert closes only when it has been acknowledged and its condition has cleared. A condition that clears by itself without acknowledgement stays in the list, so nothing is missed between shifts.

levelledPara.title: Phone alerts
levelledPara.para: If the server has an ntfy topic set, the fetch job pushes these to the operator's phone: alarm-level limit breaks, restarts, a satellite that may have gone silent, a channel starting to drift, three failed fetches in a row and low disk space. Each event is sent once. A morning summary of the last 24 hours is also sent at the configured hour.
